priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper on cooldown, provided Ascendance is either ready or has more than 10 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Ancestral Swiftness on cooldown to summon Ancestors.
Cast Ascendance on cooldown, provided Stormkeeper is currently on cooldown for at least 15 seconds.
Maintain Flame Shock on the target; use Voltaic Blaze procs to refresh it when the duration is low, ideally when Master of the Elements is not active.
Cast Lava Burst if Master of the Elements is not active and you have room for the Maelstrom, prioritizing Lava Surge procs.
Cast Tempest if Master of the Elements is active to benefit from the damage buff.
Cast Lightning Bolt if Stormkeeper is active, ideally while Master of the Elements is also active.
Cast Elemental Blast to spend Maelstrom and avoid capping.
Cast Earth Shock to spend Maelstrom if Elemental Blast is not talented or available.
Cast Tempest whenever it becomes available and you are not holding it for a Master of the Elements window.
Cast Lightning Bolt as your primary filler for Maelstrom generation.
Use Spiritwalker's Grace if forced to move for more than 6 yards.
Use Flame Shock or Frost Shock as fillers while moving if Spiritwalker's Grace is unavailable.
